notes.title: ①Custom Keybinds②London Server Added③Login Issue Fixed
notes.content: [p]Dear players,[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support! We’ve rolled out a new update to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p]	•	🎮 Custom Keybinds[/p][p]You can now freely customize your control keys to match your preferred playstyle.[/p][p]	•	🌍 New Server in London[/p][p]Players in Europe can now enjoy smoother and more stable connections with the addition of our new London server.[/p][p]	•	🛠️ Login Issue Fixed[/p][p]We’ve resolved a bug that was preventing some players from logging in. Overall stability has also been improved.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re committed to making Strange Block 36 the best it can be. Thank you for playing and for all your valuable feedback![/p][p][/p][p]— The Strange Block 36 Development Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Demo Update | New Levels & New Servers Online!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve released two exciting updates for the demo version of *Strange Block 36*! Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

🌟 What's New:

🔸 28 brand new levels added to PVE mode!  
Experience diverse new gameplay mechanics and challenges. Are you ready to push your limits?

🔸 New game servers added: US East, Europe, Japan!  
With these new server locations, players around the world can now enjoy a smoother, more stable gaming experience.

Try out the latest content and share your thoughts in the community! We’ll keep improving the game and bringing you even more exciting updates.

Thank you for your support,  
The Strange Block 36 Dev Team

notes.title: Demo Now Available! Try It Out and Share Your Feedback!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We’re excited to announce that the demo version of our game is now live on Steam! You can now download and play the core experience for free.
We’d love for you to give it a try and let us know what you think. Your feedback and bug reports are incredibly valuable and will help us polish and improve the game before full release.
Feel free to leave comments, report issues, or share suggestions in the Steam Community. You’re also welcome to join our [Discord] to chat directly with us.
Thank you for your support — and have fun playing!

notes.title: Price Changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’d like to inform you of an important upcoming change:
Our game will no longer be released as Free to Play. After careful consideration, we’ve decided to launch it as a paid title instead.

Reason for the change:
We’ve made this decision in order to better support ongoing development and provide a more complete experience at launch.

When is this change happening?
The new price will take effect when the game officially launches on.

How does this affect current players?
Since the game is not yet released and no one has downloaded or purchased it, this change will not affect any existing players.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

– The CSJL Team
